description: This Java class defines LogView, a custom TextView component used for displaying logs within an Android application. It implements the LogNode interface to format and output log details such as priority, tag, message, and throwable, and supports chaining to other LogNodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView intended for displaying log output, implementing the LogNode interface, with functionality for formatting log messages and chaining to other LogNodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats incoming log data and updates the LogView UI. Converts priority integer to string, processes throwable stack trace, constructs log line, and updates the UI thread. Also delegates to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to the StringBuilder if it is not null, separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView UI.
